Sam W: Morning — quick standup. Pipeline notes: Brightwell (POC) asking for Private deployment network allowlist and SOC2 attestation before legal will sign. PO expected but stalled on security items.
Priya K: Thanks — I updated the customer one-pager with onboarding steps and a link to our SOC2 report: https://redwood/internal/compliance/brightwell. Filing the ask under #eng-security.
Darren S: @Sam W can you paste the exact firewall CIDR they need to allow? I'll get ops to provide the gateway IPs. Also need to know whether they require HSM-backed keys or just KMS.
Sam W: They sent: "we need egress IPs + service FQDNs for allowlist, and HSM for key custody ideally". I asked for a compliance RACI doc.
Lina T: For Brightwell, commercial side: director approved budget up to $45k/mo if Private is OK. If HSM adds >10% to infra, we may need to recalc ARR.
Priya K: Noted. @Darren S — any quick blockers from security to confirm feasibility? If it's a deal blocker, we should flag for an exec decision.
Darren S: Quick read: HSM is doable on Dedicated/Private but requires procurement lead time + extra config (KMS integration + audit logs). Short answer: yes, but ETA ~3 weeks for full validation.
Sam W: OK will relay. ParcelQ update: they want Dedicated capacity numbers and expected 200 req/s steady. Asking for perf SLA.
Priya K: I pushed the perf sheet to the ParcelQ thread and pinged eng-runtime for a numbers confirmation. Link: https://redwood/internal/sheets/parcelq-capacity. @eng-runtime please chime in on expected tail latencies at 200 rps.
Darren S: For parcels, we should also confirm that request logs are redacted per their contract. I'll attach the redaction checklist to the thread.
revenue-bot: Daily pipeline summary: 3 enterprise opportunities in negotiation, 1 POC awaiting security sign-off, projected close this quarter: $120k ARR.
Sam W: Small ask — who can review a short one-paragraph technical blurb for ClearHarbor about data residency and audit logs? They need it in an RFP today.
Priya K: I can draft. If someone from eng can add the exact retention windows for audit logs (default + options), post here and I'll include.
Darren S: Audit logs retention: default 90 days, add-on up to 7 years (requires archive storage & legal agreement). I'll DM details and the compliance contact.
Lina T: Blockers: 1) Brightwell HSM timeline, 2) ParcelQ perf confirmation, 3) ClearHarbor RFP blurb. Otherwise pushing demos this afternoon.
Sam W: Thanks team — I'll update CRMs and loop legal for Brightwell PO language. If eng can aim to reply on ParcelQ by EOD that'd be awesome. :thumbsup:
Priya K: Will do — ping me if legal needs any specific wording.
Darren S: Following up with eng-security and ops now. Will post updates here when I have IPs/diags.
Lina T: Adding: if anyone wants to sync later, 3pm slot open. Quick 15m will help close gaps.
Sam W: 3pm works for me. Closing thread unless new asks. :rocket:
